actions.text:
Hi, I'm Pathfinder from GenU. I turn your goal into a plan: courses to take and openings to apply to. Which language do you prefer?

1️⃣ English
2️⃣ Naija Pidgin
3️⃣ Hausa
4️⃣ Yorùbá

Before we start: I only save your answers and your plan. Reply DELETE at any time to erase them.

How old are you? (Reply with a number)
Tell me about work you already do, even if it's informal (selling, fixing phones, farming, cooking, hair…). Don't include your name or phone number. Or reply SKIP.

Because you're under 18, a parent or guardian needs to agree before I save anything. Does your parent or guardian agree?

1️⃣ Yes, they agree
2️⃣ Not yet
Pathfinder is for young people aged 15 to 24. Reply PLAN to start again, or browse every opportunity on Yoma.
That's fine. Nothing has been saved. When they agree, reply PLAN to start again.

Your information is:
🔒 Private
🔒 Secure
🔒 Only shared with your permission

✅ Show employers what you can do, with skills from trusted programmes like FunDoo and Yoma.
✅ Find learning and earning opportunities on yoma.world.
🔒 You decide when and if you share it.
